summary: Mostly no. On BTC, ETH and SOL, KDJ(9,3,3) crosses and J extremes did the same as random entries on 1h, 4h and daily, on both the long and the short side. The clearest result is on the short side. After J crossed down through 100 on 4h, price kept rising, and shorts did 0.84% worse than random after 20 candles.

notes: On 1h, K crossing up D trailed random entries by 0.03% after 20 candles, inside the luck band. Requiring the cross to happen below 30 cuts entries to about a fifth, and the result was again the same as random on 1h, 4h and daily. On BTC 1h, the plain cross looked worse than random only because of signals between Apr 26 and May 13, 2022, during the Terra collapse.

Shorting as J crossed down through 100 on 4h did 0.84% worse than random after 20 candles. The result held without its strongest stretch and at 10, 20 and 50 candles. On SOL it was 1.3% worse at every horizon. The trend carries it: in uptrends it was 0.79% worse and held at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles, while in downtrends it was the same as random. J above 100 marked strength that continued, not a top.
On 1h, the same J cross down through 100 also looked worse than random, but only because of signals on Jan 2-3, 2021. Without them it was the same as random.

On 1h, J below 0 was the same as random pooled, but the two regimes split. In downtrends it beat random by 0.2% after 20 candles and held without its strongest stretch. It also showed at 50 candles, but not at 10 or 100. In uptrends it was the same as random. J crossing up through 0 enters about half as often, and its downtrend result rests on a single entry on Jan 13, 2023.

Shorting as K crossed down D above 80 on daily did 6.92% worse than random, but only because of 5 signals between Aug 8 and Sep 9, 2021. On 4h the same short looked worse in uptrends only because of signals between Apr 27 and May 4, 2021. In downtrends on daily it had too few moves to judge.

For a long DCA bot on these pairs, KDJ oversold timing did not change where price went, so the DCA orders and take profit decide the result. If you add a KDJ condition, J below 0 on 1h is the one to test, and only alongside a downtrend filter such as price below its 200-day SMA. For a short bot, leave J crossing down through 100 out as an entry on 4h. In uptrends, price kept rising after it fired.
